concept.title: A planned break from caring
concept.shortdesc: As the main carer of someone who needs care around the clock, I need regular planned breaks, so that I can rest and stay well enough to keep caring.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-011). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: carers, carers of people with dementia.
Situation: Feels guilty about arranging someone else to look after him, even briefly.
A good result: The kinds of respite (sitting service, day care, short stay) with how to arrange and fund each, and the carer's assessment route.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: someone to look after mum so I can have a break

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
